Manages the ApplicationAccessPolicy object via New-ApplicationAccessPolicy / Get-ApplicationAccessPolicy / Set-ApplicationAccessPolicy / Remove-ApplicationAccessPolicy.

- `app_id` (Set of String) Maps to the -AppId parameter.
